subject: Rollout readiness: Runtime v2 - docs, exceptions, and canary plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.io>
Cc: acme-platform-ops@acme.io
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rollout readiness: Runtime v2 - docs, exceptions, and canary plan

Team,

We're lining up the internal coordination for the Runtime v2 rollout that's slated to begin the week of Aug 17. Attached is the current draft of the rollout plan (runtime-v2-rollout-plan-v1.pdf). I need a few things to be confirmed by EOD Monday so we can lock the enablement schedule:

- Laura: final training deck + on-call playbook status (we need the playbook published to Confluence by Aug 10)
- Dev: confirmation on canary matrix + whether we require an SLA exception for burst capacity during the 48h ramp window
- Marissa: central comms + release-notes owner and timing (internal then public)
- Sam / Acme: any customer-specific constraints we need to bake in (window, data residency, approval gating)

A couple of known exceptions we need to track in the plan:
- Temporary increase to burst GPUs for auto-scaling in the first 48 hours (needs procurement sign-off)
- Short-term telemetry retention increase for debug traces (30 days -> 90 days)

Please annotate the attached plan with comments and upload any missing artifacts to the Drive link in related_links.

Thanks — I want this to be tight but flexible for enterprise customers in the first wave.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior PM, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: runtime-v2-rollout-plan-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 14:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollout readiness: Runtime v2 - docs, exceptions, and canary plan

+1 on the timeline. Quick status from docs/enablement:

- Training deck: draft ready, need product screenshots from Dev (token-level cost dashboard + model routing example). Target to finish by Aug 9.
- Playbook (on-call + rollback steps): outline is up on Confluence, filling in runbooks this week. Will publish by Aug 11 if Dev can confirm the canary steps.
- Release notes: I'll produce a public-facing summary + detailed internal runbook. Public summary targeted for Aug 18 (after initial smoke).

Open asks for Dev: please confirm the canary gating signals (latency p99, error rate, token loss) and the rollback threshold numbers. Also—do we expect any schema changes to the API surface that docs need to call out? If yes, mark as "breaking" and we'll schedule developer-facing notes.

Marissa — I'll need your help scheduling two enablement office hours (Aug 12 and Aug 14) with recordings for Sales and CS.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Developer Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-platform-ops@acme.io
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 08:22:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollout readiness: Runtime v2 - docs, exceptions, and canary plan

Thanks for the heads up, Jonas. A couple of quick items from Acme's side:

- We can accept a short increase in burst capacity but need notification 48h in advance and a temporary SLA amendment documenting the burst window. Can you confirm who owns that wording?
- We rely on the 30-day telemetry for billing reconciliation. Extending to 90 days is acceptable for the debug window if it's scoped to redwood-internal traces only. Can you confirm which traces are in scope?

Also, if there's a public release note mentioning Acme as a launch partner, we'll need sign-off from our legal team.

Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Platform
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 16:50:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollout readiness: Runtime v2 - docs, exceptions, and canary plan

Thanks — technical confirmation below:

- Canary gating signals: latency_p99 > 250ms sustained for 5m -> fail; error_rate > 1.5% over 10m -> fail; token_loss > 0.5% -> fail. We'll add absolute fallbacks for specific models (see canary-matrix.csv).
- API changes: no breaking changes to customer-facing endpoints. We are introducing a new query param for model_variant routing (backwards-compatible). Docs callout OK.
- Burst capacity: we can support a 48h burst window. Procurement / capacity team needs the temporary reserved quota (estimate: +20% GPU hours for week-of ramp). I can draft the technical wording for the SLA amendment — will add to the Drive link.
- Telemetry: the extended retention will be limited to diagnostic traces tagged "runtime-v2-debug" and will not include customer prompt/response payloads. Should satisfy Acme's ask.

Action items I will own this week:
1) Upload canary-matrix.csv with model-by-model thresholds.
2) Post the QA cluster access instructions to the Confluence page.
3) Draft the temporary SLA amendment text and circulate for procurement/legal.

Dev
Dev Patel
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: canary-matrix.csv (text/csv, 8KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollout readiness: Runtime v2 - docs, exceptions, and canary plan

Thanks everyone — short consolidated update and owners so we can close the loop before Monday:

- Docs & Enablement
  • Owner: Laura Bennett — publish training deck (Aug 9), playbook (Aug 11).
  • Office hours scheduled: Aug 12 & Aug 14 — Marissa to send invites by EOD today.

- Canary & Telemetry
  • Owner: Dev Patel — canary-matrix.csv uploaded, QA cluster access posted (Confluence), draft SLA amendment in Drive for review (ETA Aug 5).
  • Acme note: telemetry scope limited to "runtime-v2-debug" traces only (no customer PII/payload).

- Procurement / Capacity
  • Owner: Jonas Weber — coordinate with procurement for +20% reserved GPU hours for week-of ramp; required by Aug 10 to lock pricing.

- Communications
  • Owner: Marissa Cole — internal announcement (Aug 16), public release note (Aug 18) pending Acme legal sign-off.

Please reply only if you have objections to owners/timing. I'll merge these notes into the rollout plan and publish the updated PDF to the Drive link.
